attchmntText: Ravi Kumar Distilleries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ravi Kumar Distilleries Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board reported a loss of Rs. 68.70 Lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 145.40 Lakhs for the half year. Revenue from operations was Rs. 1,411.62 Lakhs for the quarter. The statutory auditors issued a qualified conclusion. The qualification highlights disputes regarding Rs. 2,900.25 Lakhs in amounts recoverable, investments in Liquors India Limited, and pending statutory dues of Rs. 314.70 Lakhs. The auditors noted that confirmations for certain trade receivables and payables were not obtained. An emphasis of matter notes a restatement for the quarter ended 30th June 2026, changing a reported profit of Rs. 6.83 Lakhs to a loss of Rs. 76.70 Lakhs due to an income tax refund adjustment.
